articles.title: Israeli attacks reported across south Lebanon
articles.summary: Israeli attacks reported across south Lebanon A series of Israeli attacks were reported across southern Lebanon overnight and early on Thursday.  In the towns of al-Qantara and al-Mansouri, south of Tyre, Israeli aircrafts launched strikes. Meanwhile, large explosions were reported near Bani Haiyyan and in Kfar Tebnit. Israeli forces also launched powerful explosions and air strikes in the town of Mansouri, which sent shockwaves through neighbouring villages. Further explosions and shelling were reported in Wadi Mazlam, Zawtar al-Sharqiyah, Wadi al-Hujair.
